name: bielu-aspnetcore-asyncapi-workspace
description: Root workspace for changeset-driven versioning of this repository. Not published. The assets/* members are the publishable npm packages; build/changeset/nuget-suite is the placeholder for the shared NuGet version. Each member keeps its own package-lock.json so the per-folder CI `npm ci` builds are unaffected.

scripts.version: changeset version && node scripts/apply-nuget-version.mjs && npm install --package-lock-only --no-audit --no-fund
